<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#EEF4F1"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="27" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#012F3F">9:41</text>
  <g fill="#012F3F">
    <rect x="314" y="24" width="3" height="5" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="320" y="21" width="3" height="8" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="326" y="18" width="3" height="11" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="332" y="15" width="3" height="14" rx="1"/>
    <circle cx="347" cy="23" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="350.5" y1="26.5" x2="354" y2="30" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="17" width="19" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="380" y="21" width="2" height="4" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="363.5" y="19.5" width="13" height="7" rx="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main login area -->
  <g>
    <!-- Blinkist monogram tile -->
    <rect x="155" y="82" width="80" height="80" rx="24" fill="#28E292"/>
    <rect x="173" y="101" width="16" height="42" rx="3" fill="#012F3F"/>
    <rect x="188" y="101" width="19" height="16" rx="3" fill="#012F3F"/>
    <rect x="188" y="127" width="19" height="16" rx="3" fill="#012F3F"/>
    <rect x="204" y="105" width="9" height="8" rx="2" fill="#28E292"/>
    <rect x="204" y="131" width="9" height="8" rx="2" fill="#28E292"/>
    
    <text x="195" y="198" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#012F3F">Welcome back</text>
    <text x="195" y="224" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="regular" fill="#707C81">Log in to continue your reading journey</text>
    
    <!-- Facebook button shadow and button -->
    <rect x="22" y="258" width="346" height="46" rx="5" fill="#707C8133"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="23" y="256" width="344" height="44" rx="4" fill="#02314B"/>
      <circle cx="52" cy="278" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="52" y="284" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#02314B">f</text>
      <text x="195" y="284" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="medium" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue with Facebook</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Separator -->
    <line x1="23" y1="332" x2="169" y2="332" stroke="#707C8159" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="221" y1="332" x2="367" y2="332" stroke="#707C8159" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="337" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="regular" fill="#707C81">OR</text>
    
    <!-- Email button -->
    <rect x="22" y="362" width="346" height="46" rx="5" fill="#707C8133"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="23" y="360" width="344" height="44" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#707C8133" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="43" y="374" width="19" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#2BDE80" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="44,376 52.5,382 61,376" fill="none" stroke="#2BDE80" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="195" y="388" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="medium" fill="#2BDE80">Continue with email</text>
    </g>
    
    <text x="195" y="450" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="regular" fill="#707C81">New to Blinkist?</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="120" y="466" width="150" height="36" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#2BDE80" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="195" y="489" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2BDE80">Create an account</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Trust / legal content fills lower region -->
    <rect x="23" y="538" width="344" height="1" fill="#E6FC88"/>
    <text x="195" y="572" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="regular" fill="#707C81">One account. Thousands of ideas.</text>
    <text x="195" y="596" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="regular" fill="#707C81">By continuing, you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy.</text>
    <text x="195" y="620" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="regular" fill="#2BDE80">Secure sign-in · Cancel anytime</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="696" width="390" height="110" fill="#02314B"/>
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none">
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="43,731 52,723 61,731" fill="none"/>
    <rect x="46" y="730" width="12" height="11" rx="1"/>
    <!-- Search -->
    <circle cx="130" cy="731" r="7"/>
    <line x1="135" y1="736" x2="141" y2="742"/>
    <!-- Library -->
    <rect x="201" y="723" width="17" height="18" rx="2"/>
    <line x1="205" y1="727" x2="214" y2="727"/>
    <line x1="205" y1="732" x2="214" y2="732"/>
    <line x1="205" y1="737" x2="211" y2="737"/>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="278" cy="727" r="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="278" cy="739" rx="9" ry="5"/>
    <!-- More -->
    <circle cx="345" cy="726" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="732" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="738" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
  </g>
  <text x="52" y="761" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="regular" fill="#FFFFFFB2">Home</text>
  <text x="130" y="761" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="regular" fill="#FFFFFFB2">Search</text>
  <text x="210" y="761" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="regular" fill="#FFFFFFB2">Library</text>
  <text x="278" y="761" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="regular" fill="#FFFFFFB2">Profile</text>
  <text x="345" y="761" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="regular" fill="#FFFFFFB2">More</text>
  
  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="128" y="826" width="134" height="5" rx="100" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
